sections.heading: What "household income" means here
sections.intro: Medi-Cal and Covered California use program-specific MAGI rules. California's income route for the 2027 work rule uses monthly MAGI-based household financial methods; do not equate it with gross cash receipts. Enacted §14005.69(e)(6).

sections.heading: How your three income streams are treated
The $580 test, in detail
sections.intro: No earned-wage gate, but this person's countable amount is unknown. Prior-six-month averaging under the enacted provision is for seasonal workers only; a lumpy trading month is not proof. Current correction.

sections.heading: 2026 income limits by household size
sections.intro: These are 2026 DHCS Medi-Cal FPL figures (annual DHCS Enclosure 2 and monthly Enclosure 1). They are not the 2026 marketplace 400% FPL threshold ($62,600 for one person); see separate plan-year table.

sections.heading: Why no personal dollar scenarios are filled in
sections.intro: Earlier invented rent, interest and Kalshi scenarios were removed. The resulting taxable amounts are unknown; each row cites the official general rule and flags missing personal values.
